name: Produce requirements from approved goals
does: Write requirements.md in the mise directory from the approved goals and mocks.
costNote: whole doc written in the driver's context

name: Goals as source
does: Use goals.md for intent, scope, and the clarifying Q&A folded in at the gate.

name: Mock tweaks are decisions
does: Treat every logged mock tweak as a decision the requirements must reflect.

name: Codebase as source
does: Use the codebase for existing functionality the feature integrates with or must preserve.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: requirements that break existing behavior)
costNote: unbounded source reading in the driver

name: Revise existing requirements
does: A reopened requirements.md is revised against current sources, never regenerated.
preventsClaim: a reopened stage discarding prior decisions

name: User-facing behavior only
does: Specify what the system does, never how it is built.
preventsClaim: design decisions being fixed before the plan stage

name: REQ identifiers grouped
does: Use REQ-<CATEGORY>-<N> identifiers grouped by functional area.
costNote: IDs are traced through plan task files and acceptance

name: Testable MUST SHOULD MAY
does: Use MUST/SHOULD/MAY language; every requirement testable.

name: Reference preserved behavior
does: Reference existing behavior that must be preserved.

name: Out of scope section
does: Record explored-but-deferred behavior, including mock variants that will not ship.
preventsClaim: deferred behavior being re-proposed or silently built

name: Assumptions section required
does: Record every non-obvious inference made where goals and mocks were silent.
preventsClaim: silent inferences the user never sees

name: Requirements document template
does: Fenced skeleton showing heading, REQ bullets, Out of Scope, Assumptions.
costNote: 18 lines of template restating rules on lines 15-20

name: Requirements critic gate invocation
does: Run the critic gate with kind requirements and goals.md (plus mocks) as upstream.
preventsClaim: an unreviewed requirements doc reaching the plan stage
costNote: 1 critic per round; budget 5 rounds, ceiling 8 per artifact version
